create_pixel_art_arcade: convert an image to retro pixel art using the arcade preset with 16 adaptive colors
create_pixel_art_nes: convert an image to NES-style pixel art using the official 52-color hardware palette
create_pixel_art_custom_palette: convert an image to pixel art with a custom named palette like PICO_8 and block size 6
create_pixel_art_gameboy: convert an image to Game Boy original monochrome pixel art with hardware-accurate palette
run_pixel_art_cli: run the pixel art CLI tool to convert an image using the arcade preset and save output
